name: showreel-c3-price-list

voice.text: These prices are hard to compare. They jump around. Turns out, numbers need one edge. First, align them to the right. Next, use digits of one width. Then add dots to each name. Now the cheapest stands out.

caption:
These prices are hard to compare. They jump around, because every row is centred. ✂️

1. Line every price up on one right edge.
2. Use digits of one width (tabular figures), so the columns stay straight.
3. Add dots from each name to its price.

Save this for your next price list, menu or invoice. Do you read the name first or the price first?

edges_ok.why: the design-tutorial stage (a salon's price list on a wall) fills the frame by design

before.mistake: a first-draft salon price list: every row centred, so each price sits wherever its name's width puts it, with ordinary proportional digits

note: Rebuilt on the improved design kit (27 Nov 2026; rules-c3.md V1-V3, B1-B3, P1-P2) from the gold reel showreel-c3-grey-text.
